caption:
Scammers use urgency so you won't think. ⚠️

1. Pause. Real emergencies survive a 5-minute check.
2. Contact the person on a number you already have.
3. Never act on a request just because it sounds like your boss.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

scenes.text: "Urgent! Do this right now." Stop right there.

scenes.myth: If it sounds like my boss, it's my boss.
scenes.fact: Names and tone are easy to fake. Verify it.

items: Call on a number you know

scenes.say: Three steps. Pause for five minutes. Call on a number you already know. Never use the number in the message.

scenes.title: Secrecy plus rush
scenes.body: "Don't tell anyone, do it now" is a warning sign.
scenes.say: Tip. Secrecy plus a rush is a big red flag.
